method: Mean normalized 60/90/120-second full-cast healing potential using default talents, no external buffs, and the class direct heal(s). Mana budget includes starting mana, casting Spirit regen, MP5 and average Illumination. No overheal, procs, set bonuses or cooldowns credited. Coordinate search; not a universal BiS proof.
